articles.summary: ROANOKE, Va. (May 6, 2026)–RGC Resources, Inc. (Nasdaq: RGCO) announced consolidated Company earnings of $8.7 million, or $0.84 per diluted share, for the second quarter ended March 31, 2026, compared to $7.7 million, or $0.74 per diluted share, for the second quarter ended March 31, 2025. The increase was the result of higher operating margins
articles.title: RGC Resources, Inc. Reports Second Quarter Earnings
